status: Approximate registration for display and sun studies; not survey control.
origin_note: WGS84 longitude/latitude of the model origin (Revit internal origin = Revit site location). The third value is the provisional CTRN 2002 height of P3 (orthometric, Genova 1942 levelling), not an ellipsoidal height.
rotation_note: Rotation of ENU vectors into the model XY plane, as used by the viewer (catalog location.enuToModelDegrees): the true azimuth of model +Y. Grid azimuth 53.4999 deg minus meridian convergence 1.678 deg. Translation does not affect sunlight.

model_frame.description: Revit internal coordinates of the Villa Maraini model (internal origin = booklet frame origin of the plan control); metres; P3 finished floor = 0.00.
model_frame.gltf_axes: glTF x = Revit X, glTF y = Revit Z (up), glTF z = -Revit Y.

projected.formula: X = glTF x, Y = -glTF z (metres); a = model_y_grid_azimuth_degrees; E = origin_E + X*cos(a) + Y*sin(a); N = origin_N - X*sin(a) + Y*cos(a)
projected.scale: No grid scale factor applied (factor about 0.9996 at this longitude; < 0.05 m across the site).

vertical.datum: Regione Lazio CTRN 2002 heights (provisional tie, VM-D064 / QS decision D1)

accuracy.basis: Approximate fit to the CTRN 2002 building outlines (main-roof steps, RMS 0.25 m) and eight vertical tie groups (median 68.55, SD 0.30). Field control pending.

control_points.name: model origin (Revit internal origin, P3 finished floor)

relation_to_v013.description: v013 (Blender) used its own local frame. V14 point (X, Y) in the Revit frame equals v013 Blender (Xb, Yb) = R(-1.8816149 deg) * (X, Y) + (1.953023, -0.341997); heights unchanged except the street-pinned domain (D1, -2.286 m).

sources: Revit shared coordinates (stage s13) and Project Information VM_Georeference / VM_VerticalDatum
